purpose: Normative index for accepted RFC source projection, restart-persistent terminal cascade evidence, and operation-scoped archive/restore history.
invariants: accepted current RFC source projection remains rebuildable from immutable LLD-04 source evidence
terminal source acceptance may create or supersede a pending cascade proposal but never executes downstream Task/Objective/Communication consequences by itself
terminal cascade proposal membership is immutable exact-scope evidence and execution revalidates current scope before same-UoW participants run
archive/restore provenance is operation-scoped, append-only and ordered by resulting RFC revision rather than timestamp ties
LLD-03 owns RFC lifecycle/archive/cascade evidence but not WFM Task lifecycle or Communication consequence authority
implementation_rule: Implement and migrate every declared leaf as one RFC lifecycle schema family; no leaf may be omitted or treated as optional merely because this index is the aggregate reference target.
